verdict.rationale: Autumn documents a few multi-item operations: multiAttach attaches several plans to a customer in one request, attachLicense assigns licenses to one or more entities, and the atmn CLI pushes all config-defined plans and features with one command. There is no documented general bulk API for acting on many customers or records at once. Missing for 10: bulk operations across many customers (e.g. batch track/attach/update), documented batch limits or behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Attaches multiple plans to a customer in a single request.
Assigns licenses to one or more entities.
You write your features and plans in an `autumn.config.ts` file, preview what would change, and push it to Autumn with one command.
